notes: Runs: v1 (first draft) and v2 (refined). Results go to reports/skill-evals.md. Cases 1-4 must trigger the skill; case 5 must not.

evals.prompt: Write the E2E test for AC-F1-07 (empty line) from specs/2026-11-20-f1-relay-control.
expectations: Skill e2e-test-conventions is invoked
Test name starts with test_ac_f1_07_ and has @pytest.mark.ac("AC-F1-07")
Uses host("") fixture (not raw socket, no src imports)
Asserts stdout == 'ERR EMPTY' and exit_code == 1
Asserts state unchanged via control.get_state() for an explicitly set initial state

evals.prompt: Add E2E tests for AC-F1-10: hardware fault injection, including the error-priority part.
expectations: Skill e2e-test-conventions is invoked
Injects fault via control.fault('HW_FAULT')
Covers ON and OFF -> ERR HW_FAULT, exit 1, state unchanged
Covers STATUS still working and invalid lines ('on', '') getting their own error
Covers recovery after control.fault('NONE')
No sleep, marker AC-F1-10 on every test

evals.prompt: AC-F1-11 test is flaky on CI: sometimes the host takes longer than expected. Fix the test for the silent device.
expectations: Skill e2e-test-conventions is invoked
Does not loosen the AC bound (timeout + 0.5 s) or skip/xfail/delete the test without a requirements change
Uses control.silence(True) and a short host timeout
No sleep / no retry loops hiding failures
Restores via SILENCE OFF assertion or relies on autouse reset, and asserts recovery

evals.prompt: CR-01 is accepted: relay cannot be toggled more than once per 2 s (BUSY). Write E2E tests for the new AC, boundary 2.000 s allowed.
expectations: Skill e2e-test-conventions is invoked
Uses control.advance(...) on the manual clock, never time.sleep
Tests boundary 1.999 s -> BUSY (exit 1) and 2.000 s -> OK
Covers BUSY not restarting the window and repeated same-state command not counting as toggle
Points out that requirements.md needs the CR AC IDs first if missing, instead of inventing IDs

evals.prompt: Write a unit test for the ManualClock class in src/relay_sim/clock.py: advance() must reject negative values.
expectations: Skill e2e-test-conventions is NOT invoked
Writes a plain unit test (e.g. tests/unit/) that imports relay_sim.clock directly
Does not add AC markers or E2E fixtures
